name: JL: Next Generation
source: You will dive into the rich tapestry of the DC Universe, experiencing a thrilling visual novel set in the iconic cityscapes of the DC world. This interactive narrative adventure immerses players in a world of superheroes, supervillains, and the morally ambiguous characters that inhabit the shadows.
